method: Paper folding: unfold by reflecting the cut across each fold line
steps: Fold 1: top half folded down onto bottom (horizontal fold)
Fold 2: right half folded onto left (vertical fold)
Cut on the folded quarter is a check-mark shape with a horizontal top stroke
Unfolding gives the cut in all four quarters, left/right mirror images and top/bottom mirror images
Only option B shows four shapes symmetric about both centre lines

method: Mirror on right vertical line: reverse order and laterally invert each character
steps: Figure 'M5h9sg' with vertical mirror MN on the right
Image reads right-to-left: g, s, 9, h, 5, M, each laterally inverted but not upside down
Option C shows mirrored g, s, 9, h, 5 and M in that order, upright
D shows 9 and h flipped vertically (wrong); A and B are not proper mirror images

method: Figure series: number moves around the frame, one line added each step
steps: Number increases 1,2,3,4 -> 5; lines inside hexagon increase 1,2,3,4 -> 5
Number moves anticlockwise around the hexagon: top-right, top-left, left, bottom-left -> next bottom-right
Option A has 4, D has 4 lines; B has 5 at bottom-right with 5 lines; C has 5 at bottom-left

method: Figure series: count of each symbol type
steps: P marks: 0, 0, 1, 1 -> 2 (X and P alternately increase)
Option C has 8 dots, 2 X, 2 P (12 symbols)
